note: Made from src/options.cpp by tools/snapshot_from_options_cpp.py, in the format of pcb2gcode --dump-options. Used when the installed pcb2gcode cannot describe its options.

milling.description: A front or back gerber file is given.

milldrilling.description: A drill file is given and --min-milldrill-hole-diameter isn't inf, so holes at least that wide are milled.

cutting.description: An outline is given, or holes are milldrilled.

autolevelling.description: The autoleveller is on for a side.

groups.title: Drilling options, for making holes in the PCB
Milling options, for milling traces into the PCB
Outline options, for cutting the PCB out of the FR4
Optimization options, for faster PCB creation, smaller output files, and different algorithms.
Autolevelling options, for generating gcode to automatically probe the board and adjust milling depth to the actual board height
Alignment options, useful for aligning the milling on opposite sides of the PCB
CNC options, common to all the milling, drilling, and cutting

options.name: noconfigfile
options.description: ignore any configuration file

options.name: config
options.description: list of comma-separated config files

options.name: help
options.description: produce help message

options.name: version
options.description: show the current software version

options.name: mcp
options.description: run as a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server over stdio

options.name: drill
options.description: Excellon drill file

options.name: milldrill
options.description: [DEPRECATED] Use min-milldrill-hole-diameter=0 instead

options.name: milldrill-diameter
options.description: diameter of the end mill used for drilling with --milldrill

options.name: min-milldrill-hole-diameter
options.description: minimum hole width for milldrilling. Holes smaller than this are drilled. This implies milldrill

options.name: min-milldrill-entry-diameter
options.description: minimum initial hole width for milldrilling when multiple steps are used, as a fraction of milldrill-diameter

options.name: max-milldrill-entry-diameter
options.description: maximum initial hole width for milldrilling in a single step, and the minimum size of the initial hole when multiple steps are used, as a fraction of milldrill-diameter

options.name: milldrill-stepover
options.description: maximum hole radius increase when milldrilling in multiple steps, as a fraction of milldrill-diameter

options.name: zdrill
options.description: drilling depth

options.name: zmilldrill
options.description: milldrilling depth

options.name: drill-feed
options.description: drill feed in [i/m] or [mm/m]

options.name: drill-speed
options.description: spindle rpm when drilling

options.name: drill-front
options.description: [DEPRECATED, use drill-side instead] drill through the front side of board

options.name: drill-side
options.description: drill side; valid choices are front, back or auto (default)
options.default_note: auto: the front, unless only --back is given

options.name: drills-available
options.description: list of drills available

options.name: onedrill
options.description: use only one drill bit size

options.name: drill-output
options.description: output file for drilling

options.name: nog91-1
options.description: do not explicitly set G91.1 in drill headers

options.name: nog81
options.description: replace G81 with G0+G1

options.name: nom6
options.description: do not emit M6 on tool changes

options.name: milldrill-output
options.description: output file for milldrilling

options.name: front
options.description: front side RS274-X .gbr

options.name: back
options.description: back side RS274-X .gbr

options.name: voronoi
options.description: generate voronoi regions

options.name: offset
options.description: Note: Prefer to use --mill-diameters and --milling-overlap if you just that's what you mean. An optional offset to add to all traces, useful if the bit has a little slop that you want to keep out of the trace.

options.name: mill-diameters
options.description: Diameters of mill bits, used in the order that they are provided.

options.name: milling-overlap
options.description: How much to overlap milling passes, from 0% to 100% or an absolute length

options.name: isolation-width
options.description: Minimum isolation width between copper surfaces

options.name: extra-passes
options.description: [DEPRECATED] use --isolation-width instead. Specify the the number of extra isolation passes, increasing the isolation width half the tool diameter with each pass

options.name: pre-milling-gcode
options.description: custom gcode inserted before the start of milling each trace (used to activate pump or fan or laser connected to fan)

options.name: post-milling-gcode
options.description: custom gcode inserted after the end of milling each trace (used to deactivate pump or fan or laser connected to fan)

options.name: zwork
options.description: milling depth in inches (Z-coordinate while engraving)

options.name: mill-feed
options.description: feed while isolating in [i/m] or [mm/m]

options.name: mill-vertfeed
options.description: vertical feed while isolating in [i/m] or [mm/m]

options.name: mill-infeed
options.description: maximum milling depth; PCB may be cut in multiple passes
options.default_note: the whole --zwork depth in one pass

options.name: mill-speed
options.description: spindle rpm when milling

options.name: mill-feed-direction
options.description: In which direction should all milling occur

options.name: invert-gerbers
options.description: Invert polarity of front and back gerbers, causing the milling to occur inside the shapes

options.name: draw-gerber-lines
options.description: Draw lines in the gerber file as just lines and not as filled in shapes

options.name: preserve-thermal-reliefs
options.description: generate mill paths for thermal reliefs in voronoi mode

options.name: front-output
options.description: output file for front layer

options.name: back-output
options.description: output file for back layer

options.name: outline
options.description: pcb outline polygon RS274-X .gbr

options.name: fill-outline
options.description: accept a contour instead of a polygon as outline (enabled by default)

options.name: cutter-diameter
options.description: diameter of the end mill used for cutting out the PCB

options.name: zcut
options.description: PCB cutting depth in inches

options.name: cut-feed
options.description: PCB cutting feed in [i/m] or [mm/m]

options.name: cut-vertfeed
options.description: PCB vertical cutting feed in [i/m] or [mm/m]

options.name: cut-speed
options.description: spindle rpm when cutting

options.name: cut-infeed
options.description: maximum cutting depth; PCB may be cut in multiple passes

options.name: cut-front
options.description: [DEPRECATED, use cut-side instead] cut from front side.

options.name: cut-side
options.description: cut side; valid choices are front, back or auto (default)
options.default_note: auto: the front, unless only --back is given

options.name: bridges
options.description: add bridges with the given width to the outline cut

options.name: bridgesnum
options.description: specify how many bridges should be created
options.default_note: no bridges unless --bridges is more than 0

options.name: zbridges
options.description: bridges height (Z-coordinates while engraving bridges, default to zsafe)

options.name: outline-output
options.description: output file for outline

options.name: optimise
options.description: Reduce output file size by up to 40% while accepting a little loss of precision. Larger values reduce file sizes and processing time even further. Set to 0 to disable.

options.name: eulerian-paths
options.description: Don't mill the same path twice if milling loops overlap. This can save up to 50% of milling time. Enabled by default.

options.name: vectorial
options.description: enable or disable the vectorial rendering engine

options.name: tsp-2opt
options.description: use TSP 2OPT to find a faster toolpath (but slows down gcode generation)

options.name: path-finding-limit
options.description: Use path finding for up to this many steps in the search (more is slower but makes a faster gcode path)

options.name: g0-vertical-speed
options.description: speed of vertical G0 movements, for use in path-finding

options.name: g0-horizontal-speed
options.description: speed of horizontal G0 movements, for use in path-finding

options.name: backtrack
options.description: allow retracing a milled path if it's faster than retract-move-lower. For example, set to 5in/s if you are willing to remill 5 inches of trace in order to save 1 second of milling time.
options.default_note: inf: retrace a milled path whenever that's faster

options.name: al-front
options.description: enable the z autoleveller for the front layer

options.name: al-back
options.description: enable the z autoleveller for the back layer

options.name: software
options.description: choose the destination software (useful only with the autoleveller). Supported programs are linuxcnc, mach3, mach4 and custom

options.name: al-x
options.description: max x distance between probes

options.name: al-y
options.description: max y distance bewteen probes

options.name: al-probefeed
options.description: speed during the probing

options.name: al-probe-on
options.description: execute this commands to enable the probe tool (default is M0)
options.default: (MSG, Attach the probe tool)@M0 ( Temporary machine stop. )

options.name: al-probe-off
options.description: execute this commands to disable the probe tool (default is M0)

options.description: custom probe code (default is G31)

options.name: al-probevar

options.name: al-setzzero
options.description: gcode for setting the actual position as zero (default is G92 Z0)

options.name: x-offset

options.name: y-offset
options.description: offset the origin in the y-axis by this length

options.name: zero-start
options.description: set the starting point of the project at (0,0)

options.name: mirror-absolute
options.description: [DEPRECATED, must always be true] mirror back side along absolute zero instead of board center

rules.message: --spinup-time can't be negative.
--spindown-time can't be negative.
--tolerance can't be negative. Leave it out to use the default.
--tile-x must be at least 1.
--tile-y must be at least 1.
--al-x must be greater than 0.
--al-y must be greater than 0.
--al-probefeed must be greater than 0.
--mill-feed must be greater than 0.
--mill-vertfeed must be greater than 0.
--mill-infeed must be greater than 0.
--mill-speed can't be negative.
--drill-feed must be greater than 0.
--drill-speed can't be negative.
--zcut can't be above 0, the surface of the board.
--cut-feed must be greater than 0.
--cut-vertfeed must be greater than 0.
--cut-speed can't be negative.
--cut-infeed must be at least 0.001in.
--bridges can't be negative.
--milldrill-stepover must be greater than 0% and at most 100%.
--min-milldrill-entry-diameter must be greater than 100%, which is the milldrill diameter.
--zsafe must be higher than --zwork.
--zsafe must be higher than --zdrill.
--zchange must be higher than --zdrill. If --zchange is a machine coordinate, add --zchange-absolute.
--zsafe must be higher than --zcut.
--max-milldrill-entry-diameter can't be less than --min-milldrill-entry-diameter.
--mirror-absolute=false isn't supported anymore. Remove it, and use --mirror-axis to choose where the back side is mirrored.
--mill-feed-direction doesn't work with --tsp-2opt, which is on by default. Add --tsp-2opt=false.
--vectorial=false isn't supported anymore. Remove it.
--drill-front and --drill-side can't both be set. --drill-front is deprecated, so use only --drill-side.
--cut-front and --cut-side can't both be set. --cut-front is deprecated, so use only --cut-side.
